title: VeloraOS 2.0.0 - Aurora Redesign
releaseNotes: Introduces the redesigned Aurora shell with a persistent workspace model across desktop and mobile.
Adds Today for recent work, system health, background activity, trusted devices and quick actions.
Evolves the Command Palette into Velora Search with command, device, Knowledge and settings scopes.
Adds the OLED-friendly Midnight appearance and applies the new design system across existing VeloraOS workspaces.
Preserves accounts, chats, Knowledge, Device Continuity, Time Machine, Flow, plugins, Activity Centre and Local Intelligence during in-place migration.
